about: Modwerk source-only qperf package for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, compiled from sdk/analog-rytm-mkii/modules/qperf.

mods.title: QPERF
mods.summary: Set performance locks by holding QPER and turning knobs, apply them to the kit, and record performance moves in LIVE RECORDING.
mods.description: Hold QPER and turn a knob: it edits that parameter's offset in the performance linked to QPER, and the knob inverts and shows it as it does for a held performance pad. QPER + PLAY clears it and PLAY again undoes that. QPER + RECORD and STOP copy and paste it. QPER + YES writes what you hear into the kit and removes those locks. In LIVE RECORDING the pads, the QPER knob and MIDI performance moves are kept in a quick perf rec that loops with the pattern; RECORD + YES writes it into the pattern as locks, RECORD + NO clears it.
mods.author: npp1993
mods.on_unit: The author's Analog Rytm MKII on OS 1.74 ran QL19, this code linked alone on the plain base and the same image this package links to, on 6 November 2026 (RECORD + YES/NO in each recording mode, a take and its apply); QT01 to QT08 ran earlier 0.2.0 builds with a debug trace, and QC13 the 0.1.0 code, as TESTING.md records. The package file itself has not been loaded from the site.
